backcastNote: No rows with is_backcast_period = Y exist in fact_material_movement_part_001..003, fact_inventory_snapshot_part_001..004, fact_purchase_order, fact_purchase_requisition or fact_goods_receipt (all counted 0 in this run). No backcast rows are included.

source.sql: SELECT 'PLANT' AS k, "PLANT_ID" AS code, "PLANT_NAME" AS name, "PLANT_TYPE" AS extra, "REGION_LABEL" AS extra2 FROM public."DIM_PLANT" WHERE "PLANT_ID" = 'HZL_DEMO_01' UNION ALL SELECT 'GROUP', "MATERIAL_GROUP", "MATERIAL_GROUP", "BASE_UOM", '' FROM public."REF_MATERIAL_GROUP" UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'TYPE', "MATERIAL_TYPE", "MATERIAL_TYPE", '', '' FROM public."DIM_MATERIAL" WHERE "MATERIAL_TYPE" IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') UNION ALL SELECT 'CRITICALITY', "CRITICALITY", "CRITICALITY", "SERVICE_LEVEL_PCT"::text, '' FROM public."REF_CRITICALITY" UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'MOVEMENT_CLASS', "MOVEMENT_CLASS", "MOVEMENT_CLASS", '', '' FROM public."INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION" WHERE "PLANT_ID" = 'HZL_DEMO_01' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'INVENTORY_STATUS', "INVENTORY_STATUS", "INVENTORY_STATUS", '', '' FROM public."INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION" WHERE "PLANT_ID" = 'HZL_DEMO_01' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 'DISCLAIMER', 'DISCLAIMER', "DISCLAIMER", '', '' FROM public."INVENTORY_KPI_MONTHLY" UNION ALL SELECT 'ASOF', 'ASOF', to_char(max("AS_OF_DATE"),'YYYY-MM-DD'), '', '' FROM public."INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION" WHERE "PLANT_ID" = 'HZL_DEMO_01' ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT "POSTING_MONTH" AS month, "PLANT_ID" AS plant_id, "KPI_CODE" AS kpi_code, "KPI_VALUE" AS kpi_value, "KPI_UOM" AS kpi_uom, "SCENARIO_LABEL" AS scenario FROM public."INVENTORY_KPI_MONTHLY" WHERE "PLANT_ID" = 'HZL_DEMO_01' ORDER BY "POSTING_MONTH", "KPI_CODE", "SCENARIO_LABEL"

SELECT ic."PLANT_ID" AS plant_id, dm."MATERIAL_GROUP" AS material_group, dm."MATERIAL_TYPE" AS material_type, g."BASE_UOM" AS uom, dm."CRITICALITY" AS criticality, ic."MOVEMENT_CLASS" AS movement_class, ic."INVENTORY_STATUS" AS inventory_status, ic."ABC_CLASS" AS abc_class, COUNT(*) AS materials, SUM(ic."AVAILABLE_QTY") AS available_qty, SUM(ic."INVENTORY_VALUE_INR") AS value_inr FROM public."INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION" ic JOIN public."DIM_MATERIAL" dm ON dm."MATERIAL_ID" = ic."MATERIAL_ID" JOIN public."REF_MATERIAL_GROUP" g ON g."MATERIAL_GROUP" = dm."MATERIAL_GROUP" WHERE ic."PLANT_ID" = 'HZL_DEMO_01' AND dm."MATERIAL_TYPE" IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') GROUP BY ic."PLANT_ID", dm."MATERIAL_GROUP", dm."MATERIAL_TYPE", g."BASE_UOM", dm."CRITICALITY", ic."MOVEMENT_CLASS", ic."INVENTORY_STATUS", ic."ABC_CLASS" ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8

SELECT ic."MATERIAL_ID" AS material_id, ic."PLANT_ID" AS plant_id, dm."MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION" AS description, dm."MATERIAL_GROUP" AS material_group, dm."MATERIAL_TYPE" AS material_type, g."BASE_UOM" AS uom, dm."CRITICALITY" AS criticality, ic."ABC_CLASS" AS abc_class, ic."XYZ_CLASS" AS xyz_class, ic."MOVEMENT_CLASS" AS movement_class, ic."INVENTORY_STATUS" AS inventory_status, SUM(ic."AVAILABLE_QTY") AS available_qty, SUM(ic."INVENTORY_VALUE_INR") AS value_inr, MAX(ic."DAYS_ON_HAND") AS days_on_hand, MAX(ic."DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CONSUMPTION") AS days_since_last_consumption, MAX(ic."SAFETY_STOCK_QTY") AS safety_stock_qty, MAX(ic."REORDER_POINT_QTY") AS reorder_point_qty, MAX(ic."MAX_STOCK_QTY") AS max_stock_qty, MAX(ic."TRAILING_12M_DEMAND_QTY") AS trailing_12m_demand_qty FROM public."INVENTORY_CLASSIFICATION" ic JOIN public."DIM_MATERIAL" dm ON dm."MATERIAL_ID" = ic."MATERIAL_ID" JOIN public."REF_MATERIAL_GROUP" g ON g."MATERIAL_GROUP" = dm."MATERIAL_GROUP" WHERE ic."PLANT_ID" = 'HZL_DEMO_01' AND dm."MATERIAL_TYPE" IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') GROUP BY ic."MATERIAL_ID", ic."PLANT_ID", dm."MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION", dm."MATERIAL_GROUP", dm."MATERIAL_TYPE", g."BASE_UOM", dm."CRITICALITY", ic."ABC_CLASS", ic."XYZ_CLASS", ic."MOVEMENT_CLASS", ic."INVENTORY_STATUS" ORDER BY ic."MATERIAL_ID"

SELECT r."RECOMMENDATION_ID" AS recommendation_id, r."MATERIAL_ID" AS material_id, r."PLANT_ID" AS plant_id, dm."MATERIAL_GROUP" AS material_group, dm."MATERIAL_TYPE" AS material_type, g."BASE_UOM" AS uom, dm."CRITICALITY" AS criticality, r."PRIORITY" AS priority, to_char(r."RECOMMENDED_PR_DATE",'YYYY-MM-DD') AS recommended_pr_date, r."RECOMMENDED_QTY" AS recommended_qty, r."ESTIMATED_VALUE_INR" AS estimated_value_inr, r."AVAILABLE_QTY" AS available_qty, r."OPEN_PR_QTY" AS open_pr_qty, r."OPEN_PO_QTY" AS open_po_qty, r."SAFETY_STOCK_QTY" AS safety_stock_qty, r."REORDER_POINT_QTY" AS reorder_point_qty, r."RECOMMENDATION_REASON" AS reason, r."SHUTDOWN_ID" AS shutdown_id FROM public."REORDER_RECOMMENDATION" r JOIN public."DIM_MATERIAL" dm ON dm."MATERIAL_ID" = r."MATERIAL_ID" JOIN public."REF_MATERIAL_GROUP" g ON g."MATERIAL_GROUP" = dm."MATERIAL_GROUP" WHERE r."PLANT_ID" = 'HZL_DEMO_01' AND dm."MATERIAL_TYPE" IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') ORDER BY r."RECOMMENDATION_ID"

SELECT b."CALENDAR_MONTH" AS month, b."PLANT_ID" AS plant_id, b."MATERIAL_GROUP" AS material_group, b."MATERIAL_TYPE" AS material_type, g."BASE_UOM" AS uom, b."SHUTDOWN_DRIVEN" AS shutdown_driven, b."PLAN_VALUE_INR" AS plan_value_inr, b."ACTUAL_PO_VALUE_INR" AS actual_po_value_inr, b."ACTUAL_GR_VALUE_INR" AS actual_gr_value_inr, b."VARIANCE_INR" AS variance_inr, CASE WHEN b."PLAN_VALUE_INR" = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(b."VARIANCE_INR" / b."PLAN_VALUE_INR" * 100, 2) END AS variance_pct FROM public."BUSINESS_PLAN_VS_ACTUAL" b JOIN public."REF_MATERIAL_GROUP" g ON g."MATERIAL_GROUP" = b."MATERIAL_GROUP" WHERE b."PLANT_ID" = 'HZL_DEMO_01' AND b."MATERIAL_TYPE" IN ('ZSPR','ZSPN') ORDER BY b."CALENDAR_MONTH", b."MATERIAL_GROUP", b."MATERIAL_TYPE", b."SHUTDOWN_DRIVEN"
